answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 39528 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is it ok to do any work according to a dream Question: Is it ok to do any work according to a dream? Answer ID: 39528 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 402/374/N=1433) If a dream indicates towards any good or lawful task then there is no harm in doing the same as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
